title: One-object rebuild loop for the kernel that runs on the phone: recompile one changed source file of the STR-041 1042-object index with its recorded recipe, relink with STR-041's driver, rerun its checks and NAT-020's entry stubs; first prove an unchanged rebuild reproduces kernel.unstripped (4c9536d8...)
acceptance: An unchanged relink from the STR-041 index reproduces kernel.unstripped byte-for-byte, or the differing bytes are listed and explained

One source file (a harmless IOLog string in MiniIOMobileFramebuffer.cpp) is changed, only its object is recompiled with the recorded argv, the kernel relinks, passes STR-041's segment/entry/import checks, and the string is in the binary
NAT-020's deny_storage stubs apply unchanged to the rebuilt kernel
steps: Read STR-041 evidence/execution-plan.json for the object recipe format and the link driver
Relink unchanged, compare; then the one-file change
notes: Prerequisite for any kernel-side graphics change (MiniIOSurface fixes after NAT-113, GPU-007 IOService). See research/notes/GPU-chain-2026-11-13.md. KRN-043 is related but blocked by the auto-mode classifier on executing upstream build scripts; this task uses the project's own recorded recipes.
